cse_baseline.method: Reconstructed distributed CSE TP3 patch over upstream base; not original CSE commit history.

omitted_snapshot_files.memory.md: Inherited non-build operational notes contained credentials. Excluded from every published commit and patch artifact.

verification: All retained source files checked byte-for-byte against frozen build inventory; no build or benchmark rerun for publication.
retained_formatting_note: The frozen qwen3moe-qkv-prefix-q8-128.h ends with a blank line; preserved to maintain source identity.
limitations: Earlier plan11 PPL8 and handoff evidence used snapshot 20261028-070726-571346.
560-chunk decode PPL and complete long-decode benchmark matrix not completed.
The measured source predates subsequent RPC UID-cache lifetime repair; this publication does not include that unmeasured fix.
Runtime binaries, model weights, datasets, credentials, SDKs, and later experiments are not included.

sanitization.description: Published evidence substitutes configurable placeholders for cluster addresses, host aliases, absolute installation/model/workspace paths and the network-interface name. Timing samples, execution counters, settings unrelated to location, and source/binary hashes are unchanged.

placeholders.MODEL: Path to the first existing GGUF model shard.
placeholders.TP3_BUILD: Build directory for the measured source.
placeholders.TP3_RUN_DIR: Directory for one benchmark run and its temporary files.
placeholders.TP3_SOURCE_SNAPSHOT: Directory of the archived source snapshot identified by source_snapshot.
placeholders.TP3_ARTIFACTS: Private artifact staging directory visible inside a peer namespace.
placeholders.TP3_RPC_RANK0: Rank0 RPC address, without a port.
placeholders.TP3_RPC_RANK1: Rank1 RPC address, without a port.
placeholders.TP3_RPC_RANK2: Rank2 RPC address, without a port.
placeholders.TP3_SOCKET_IFNAME: NCCL bootstrap network-interface name for the process.

sanitization.host_labels: rank0, rank1 and rank2 replace machine aliases, including RPC command-map keys.
sanitization.original_evidence_hashes: original_evidence_sha256 identifies private archived originals; evidence_sha256 verifies the published copies.
sanitization.runtime_manifest_note: The invocation artifact_manifest_sha256 records the original runtime manifest identity. It does not hash the sanitized runtime-manifest.json representation.
